question: Who among the following leaders led the Bardoli Satyagraha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vallabhbhai Patel **__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vallabhbhai Patel:-**

 
 
• **He was also related to Bardoli Satyagraha.**
 
• He is known as the Iron Man of India.
 
• The women of Bardoli bestowed the title "Sardar" on Vallabhbhai Patel for his leadership during the Bardoli Satyagraha in 1928.
 
• It was during the struggle and after the Indian National
 
• Congress victory in Bardoli Satyagraha, that Patel first began to be referred to as Sardar.
 
• He is also known as the Bismarck of India because he had played a major role in uniting India.
 
 
 
• **Bardoli Satyagraha:-**
 
 
• **It is an event in the Indian Freedom struggle against the rise in tax during times of financial troubles.**
 
• It took place in the town of Bardoli (Gujarat) in the year 1928.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lala Lajpat Rai (1865 – 1928):-**

 
 
• He is also known as "Punjab Kesari" (Lion of Punjab).
 
• He was an Indian freedom fighter, politician, and social reformer who played a significant role in India's struggle for independence from British rule.
 
• He was born in Punjab, which is now in modern-day Pakistan. Rai was one of the prominent leaders of the Indian National Congress during the early 20th century.
 
 
 
• **Motilal Nehru (1861 – 1931):-**
 
 
• **He** was an Indian lawyer, politician, and prominent leader in the Indian National Congress during the colonial era.
 
• He was a key figure in the Indian independence movement and played a significant role in shaping the political landscape of pre-independence India.
 
• He was the father of Jawaharlal Nehru, who later became the first Prime Minister of India.
 
 
 
• **Chakravarti Rajagopalachari:-**
 
 
• He was commonly known as C. Rajagopalachari or Rajaji (1878 – 1972),
 
• He was an Indian lawyer, statesman, freedom fighter, and one of the prominent leaders in the Indian National Congress.
 
• He played a multifaceted role in the struggle for India's independence and later in the post-independence period.
 
• He is also known for being the last Governor-General of India before the country became a republic.
